projectsIntro: Two tools I built at Samsic Facility to speed up prospecting. You can try them here.

scrapper.name: Mail Scrapper V4.2
scrapper.description: From a first name, last name and company, the tool generates likely addresses, verifies them through an API and caches the results so the same check is never paid for twice.
scrapper.hint: Run it again with the same values to see the cache at work.
